covers: Wall Street open and the JSE close on Thursday 12 November 2026 (to 16:40 SAST)
headline: Breaking: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO and Colette Kress is named interim chief; Nvidia falls about 8% and drags the Nasdaq lower at the open
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned and Colette Kress has been named interim CEO; the shares were at $159.28 at 16:40 SAST, down 8.3% from Wednesday's $173.70 close, and the Nasdaq opened sharply lower (CNBC and MarketWatch headlines, 12 Nov 2026; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026 16:40 SAST). The JSE All Share was at 112,805.15 and the Top 40 at 104,884.70 at 16:40 SAST, lower again than the 15:39 reading, with gold miners down 3-5% (LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026). The rand firmed slightly to R16.68/$ while gold stayed under $4,000 at $3,907.50 and the US 10-year yield was 5.03% (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026 16:40 SAST).

items.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO; Colette Kress named interim chief
items.summary: Nvidia's chief executive has resigned and the board has named Colette Kress as interim CEO, following earlier reports that the board was preparing to remove him. Nvidia was at $159.28 at 16:40 SAST, down 8.3% from Wednesday's close of $173.70; CNBC's headline puts the fall at nearly 10% at one stage. Moneyweb describes the move as an ouster by the board.
items.source: CNBC headlines, 12 Nov 2026 16:38-16:39 SAST; Moneyweb headline, 12 Nov 2026 16:19 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance NVDA), 12 Nov 2026 16:40 SAST and 11 Nov 2026 close

items.title: Nasdaq and S&P 500 open lower on the Nvidia news
items.summary: The Nasdaq Composite was at 25,334.44 and the S&P 500 at 7,592.24 at 16:40 SAST, against Wednesday's closes of 25,466.19 and 7,619.38.
items.source: MarketWatch headline, 12 Nov 2026 16:34 SAST; CNBC headline, 12 Nov 2026 16:38 SAST; LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^IXIC, ^GSPC), 12 Nov 2026 16:40 SAST and 11 Nov 2026 close

items.title: AMD and Broadcom rise as Nvidia falls
items.summary: AMD was up 3.3% at $570.95 and Broadcom up 5.2% at $363.16 at 16:40 SAST. CNBC reports an analyst upgrade of AMD on the view that it benefits from Nvidia's leadership vacuum.
items.source: CNBC headline, 12 Nov 2026 16:31 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance AMD, AVGO), 12 Nov 2026 16:40 SAST

items.title: Weekly jobless claims rise to 200,000
items.summary: US initial jobless claims rose to 200,000 last week, according to Kitco's report on the data released at 15:30 SAST. The US 10-year Treasury yield was 5.03% at 16:40 SAST.
items.source: Kitco headline, 12 Nov 2026 15:31 SAST; LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^TNX), 12 Nov 2026 16:40 SAST

items.title: Nebius falls 10% on a weak outlook and higher spending plans

items.title: Nvidia: CEO resigns, interim chief named; shares down 8.3%
items.summary: The LRC Stock Scanner rated Nvidia HOLD (fair value) at Wednesday's $173.70 close; at $159.28 the shares are below the $210.96 price used in the LRC Watchlist investment list (23 Oct 2026). The rating is unchanged here and is reassessed by the scanner on its next run. Results are still expected on 17 November; whether the date or guidance changes is the next thing to watch.
items.source: CNBC headline, 12 Nov 2026 16:38 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance), 11 Nov 2026 close and 12 Nov 2026 16:40 SAST; LRC Watchlist, 7 Nov 2026
